N copies of an environment to train in.

Picks an environment from the ones the Engine and the loaded plugins offer (CartPole-v1 is built in; the MuJoCo Simulation plugin adds InvertedPendulum-v5 and HalfCheetah-v5) and steps several copies side by side. Its observation feeds the policy and value layers; its Environment pin goes to PPO. The environment's own settings come from its plugin.

| | |

## Inputs

None: the node starts a branch of the graph.

## Outputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Observation** | Tensor | Yes | 1 | What each copy observes, [copies, observation size]: connect it to the first policy and value layers. |
| **Environment** | Environment | Yes | 1 | The copies themselves: connect it to PPO's Environment. |

## Settings

| Group | Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Environment | Environment | `environment` | Text | `cyxwiz.builtin:CartPole-v1` |   | The run | The environment, as &lt;provider>:&lt;id> (the built-in ones are cyxwiz.builtin) Required. |
| Environment | Copies | `copies` | Integer | `8` | `1-1024` | The run | Copies stepped side by side; one rollout is copies x steps per copy. Required. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.

## Support

| Aspect | Value | Supported | Why |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Workflow Lane | reinforcement learning | Yes | GraphCompiler compiles the RL graph and the Engine's PPO (core/rl) trains it on the environment's copies; PipelineExecutor and the supervised trainer do not run it. |
| Implementation Owner | rl trainer | Yes | As above |
| Support State | real | Yes | As above |

## Usage

```text
Environment -> Dense -> Tanh -> Dense -> Tanh -> Policy Head -> PPO
```
